messages.subject: 請教下載library(Rcmdr)不成功
parts:
下載library套件後使用不成功.出現下列說明.求救如何解決

> library(Rcmdr)
Loading required package: splines
Loading required package: RcmdrMisc
Loading required package: car
Error in loadNamespace(i, c(lib.loc, .libPaths()), versionCheck = vI[[i]]) :
  there is no package called ‘Rcpp’
錯誤: package ‘car’ could not be loaded

messages.author: d42e88b7645d03c8
messages.subject: Re: 請教下載library(Rcmdr)不成功
parts:
Hi 思樺,

依照 Error ... there is no package called ‘Rcpp’ 錯誤訊息, 表示尚未安裝 Rcpp 套件, 記得先安裝Rcpp套件:

install.packages("Rcpp")

結論: 在安裝 Rcmdr 過程中如有出現 Error ... there is no package called ‘xxx’ , 表示須先安裝 xxx 套件.
# end
